query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Audit and maintain Pipedrive CRM data: find deals and contacts, inspect activities/notes/pipeline stages, analyze sales-development activity hygiene, move long-horizon deals to a long-term review stage, create follow-up tasks for deals without future activity, and reassign mismatched deal owners.
query_ground_truth.intent: Search and retrieve specific deals and contacts within the Pipedrive CRM.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if saved constraints exist)] [Prerequisite]: List available deal filters using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_FILTERS (select a filter matching pipeline/stage/owner rules).
[Optional (if filtering uses custom fields)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch deal field metadata using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS (map labels/options to internal keys, including address-like subkeys).
[Optional (if query can be reduced by keywords)] [Step]: Narrow the candidate set using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS (collect deal IDs for later hydration/validation).
[Required] [Step]: Pull recently changed deals since the window start using PIPEDRIVE_GET_RECENTS (items=deal; paginate via additional_data.pagination.more_items_in_collection and next_start).

[Required] [Next Step]: From each PIPEDRIVE_GET_RECENTS wrapper, read the nested deal at item.data, de-duplicate deal IDs, normalize nested-ID fields to primitives, and client-filter to the end cutoff using the chosen timestamp fields.
[Required] [Next Step]: Enrich shortlisted IDs using PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL (confirm current status/pipeline/stage and normalize activity-related and close/win/loss dates for reporting).
[Optional (if exact status/stage timing is required)] [Next Step]: Audit key field transitions using PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL_CHANGELOG (derive when changes occurred within the reporting window).

[Fallback (if PIPEDRIVE_GET_RECENTS/PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS return nothing or constraints can’t be expressed)] [Fallback]: Enumerate using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS (paginate via response.data.additional_data.pagination.next_start; reduce limit on payload errors), then client-filter and spot-check with PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL.
known_pitfalls: [PIPEDRIVE_GET_RECENTS] Rows are change-event wrappers; the deal ID is item.data.id (not the outer event id).
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_RECENTS] Only a start boundary is supported; enforce end-of-window filtering client-side.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_RECENTS] May return success=true with data=null; treat as no matches and switch to the fallback.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS] ToolRouterV2_PayloadTooLarge (HTTP 413) can occur on large pages; lower limit and/or pre-narrow via PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS.

[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS] Some fields that look like scalar IDs (for example pipeline/stage/owner) may be nested objects; normalize before joins/grouping, and treat repeated SSL/DNS errors as configuration issues rather than retryable failures.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Paginate PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS and count deals within a client-side date window
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
from collections import Counter
start=0
limit=500
count=0
by_status=Counter()
while True:
  res,err=run_composio_tool('PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS',{'limit':limit,'start':start,'status':'all_not_deleted'})
  if err: raise RuntimeError(err)
  payload=(res or {}).get('data') or {}
  for d in (payload.get('data') or []):
    created=(d.get('add_time') or '')[:10]
    if created and start_date<=created<=end_date:
      count+=1
      by_status[d.get('status') or 'unknown']+=1
  pag=((payload.get('additional_data') or {}).get('pagination') or {})
  if not pag.get('more_items_in_collection') or pag.get('next_start') is None: break
  start=pag.get('next_start')
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=pipedrive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="pipedrive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any pipedrive tools.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS.description: Returns all deals. For more information, see the tutorial for getting all deals.

sort.description: The field names and sorting mode separated by a comma (`field_name_1 ASC`, `field_name_2 DESC`). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys).

limit.description: Items shown per page (1-500). If not provided, 100 items will be returned.

status.description: Only fetch deals with a specific status. If omitted, all not deleted deals are returned. If set to deleted, deals that have been deleted up to 30 days ago will be included.

user_id.description: If supplied, only deals matching the given user will be returned. However, `filter_id` and `owned_by_you` takes precedence over `user_id` when supplied.

stage_id.description: If supplied, only deals within the given stage will be returned

filter_id.description: The ID of the filter to use

owned_by_you.description: When supplied, only deals owned by you are returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `owned_by_you` when both are supplied.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL.description: Tool to get details of a specific deal in Pipedrive. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a deal by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the deal to retrieve

custom_fields.description: Comma-separated list of custom field keys to include (maximum 15 keys). Use this parameter for faster results and smaller responses when only specific custom fields are needed.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response. Acceptable values: next_activity_id, last_activity_id, first_won_time, products_count, files_count, notes_count, followers_count, email_messages_count, activities_count, done_activities_count, undone_activities_count, participants_count, last_incoming_mail_time, last_outgoing_mail_time, smart_bcc_email

PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL_CHANGELOG.description: Tool to list updates about deal field values. Use when you need to retrieve the changelog history showing all changes made to a specific deal's field values.

limit.description: Number of items to display per page. Controls the size of each paginated response.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the first item on the next page. Use the cursor returned in the response to fetch the next page.

PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS.description: This API endpoint searches deals by title, notes, and custom fields, filters results by person or or...

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS.description: Returns data about all deal fields.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_RECENTS.description: Returns data about all recent changes occurred after the given timestamp.
